_README: Event calendar for the daily build. Each entry can optionally reference a scraper module. Trigger types: 'first_tuesday_monthly' runs on the first Tuesday of each month; 'annual_window' runs during the listed months; 'manual' requires explicit dates in the 'dates' array (YYYY-MM-DD). The build shows upcoming events within lookahead_days and runs any attached scraper when the event is due.

events.label: Purdue Ag Economy Barometer
events.notes: Purdue/CME Group sentiment index of 400 ag producers. Published first Tuesday each month.

events.label: Indiana Farmland Values & Cash Rents Survey
events.notes: Annual survey conducted in June, results published shortly after. Check URL for new release.

events.label: Purdue Crop Cost & Return Guide
events.notes: Annual cost/return projections for corn, soybeans, wheat. Typically released in fall.

events.label: Booker Prize Longlist
events.notes: Longlist announced ~July each year. Not the Pulitzer.

events.label: IPCC Assessment Reports
events.notes: Add dates manually when Purdue announces a new report release. Check ipcc.ch/news.

events.label: Federal Reserve FOMC Statement
events.notes: Add FOMC statement dates from the Fed calendar each year. 8 meetings annually.
